user.title: HY300 Projector
user.description: Projector IP address. The Lumina Go API answers on port 8899 while the projector is on.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the projector. Is it on and connected to Wi-Fi?

init.title: IR power-on and ADB
init.description: While the projector is off its network is down, so power-on goes over IR: pick the remote entity (IR blaster) and the device/command learned with remote.learn_command. ADB (optional) lets Home Assistant open any app and show the app on screen.

data.ir_retry: Resend the IR once if the projector is not on after 75 s
data.adb_enabled: Use ADB (open apps, show current app)
